# Facebook Likes and Reactions Scraper

The Apify actor [`apify/facebook-likes-scraper`](https://apify.com/apify/facebook-likes-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.358**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Extract Facebook likes data from one or multiple Facebook posts. Get post URL, reaction type (like, love, care, sad, angry, laugh), and basic liker info such as Facebook name and profile URL. Download the data in JSON, CSV Excel and use it in apps, spreadsheets, and reports.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Result $0.0062 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/facebook-likes-scraper) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-facebook-likes-scraper@0.0.358#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      startUrls: []
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `startUrls` | array | yes |  | Facebook URLs — Valid facebook URL |
| `resultsLimit` | integer |  |  | Results amount — If this limit is not set as many results as possible are returned |

## Output

Each dataset item is typed from the actor's published dataset schema. Every field may be null, and items may carry fields beyond these.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `facebookUrl` | string \| null | URL of the Facebook post or page the reaction was left on. |
| `reaction` | string \| null | Type of reaction (e.g. like, love, haha, wow, sad, angry, care). |
| `name` | string \| null | Name of the user who reacted. |
| `profileUrl` | string \| null | URL of the reacting user's Facebook profile. |
| `profilePicture` | string \| null | URL of the reacting user's profile picture. |
